as_told.title: UFOs at CERN and the Brookhaven Cosmotron
as_told.place_text: CERN, Switzerland; Brookhaven National Lab, New York

plain: Jesse Michels says that UFOs seem, by anecdote, to show up around high-voltage experiments and particle accelerators, the big machines that smash tiny particles together. In a later episode with a Secretary of Energy he calls it rumor and names two places: the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, a large particle accelerator lab in Europe, and the Cosmotron, an accelerator at Brookhaven National Laboratory in the United States. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a hint that whatever these objects are, they may be drawn to powerful energy experiments.
